docs.heading: API Endpoint Reference
docs.lead: All available SVG card, status, and health endpoints. Load any card directly into the builder or inspect live JSON responses.

deployment.heading: Cloudflare Pages & Workers Deployment
deployment.lead: Configure these Environment Variables / Secrets in your Cloudflare dashboard or wrangler.toml.

vars.name: PAT_1, PAT_2, ...
vars.desc: GitHub Personal Access Tokens rotated automatically when rate limits hit.

vars.name: GITHUB_USERNAME
vars.desc: Default username fallback when username query parameter is omitted.

vars.name: README_THEME
vars.desc: Default theme fallback when theme query parameter is omitted.

vars.name: README_LOCALE
vars.desc: Default card language fallback when locale query parameter is omitted.

vars.name: README_INCLUDE_ALL_COMMITS
vars.desc: Count all lifetime commits by default when include_all_commits is omitted.

vars.name: README_LANGS_COUNT
vars.desc: Default number of languages shown on top-langs when langs_count is omitted.

vars.name: CACHE_SECONDS
vars.desc: Custom CDN cache lifetime in seconds.

vars.name: WHITELIST
vars.desc: Comma-separated list of allowed GitHub usernames.

vars.name: GIST_WHITELIST
vars.desc: Comma-separated list of allowed Gist IDs.

vars.name: EXCLUDE_REPO
vars.desc: Comma-separated repository names excluded globally from card stats.

vars.name: FETCH_MULTI_PAGE_STARS
vars.desc: Enable multi-page GraphQL star fetching for accounts with over 100 repositories.

/api.label: Stats Card
/api.summary: Generate GitHub account stats card (stars, commits, PRs, issues, rank).

/api/streak.label: Streak Card
/api/streak.summary: Generate GitHub contribution streak card (total, current, and longest streak).

/api/top-langs.label: Top Languages
/api/top-langs.summary: Visualize most used programming languages across repositories.
/api/top-langs.aliases: Layouts: normal, compact, donut, donut-vertical, pie

/api/pin.label: Pinned Repo
/api/pin.summary: Generate repository pin card with stars, forks, language, and description.

/api/wakatime.label: WakaTime Card
/api/wakatime.summary: Display coding activity from a public WakaTime profile.

/api/gist.label: Gist Card
/api/gist.summary: Generate a card displaying metadata and stars for a GitHub Gist.

/api/status/up.label: PAT Uptime
/api/status/up.summary: Check whether configured GitHub Personal Access Tokens are operational.

/api/status/pat-info.label: PAT Diagnostics
/api/status/pat-info.summary: Inspect valid, expired, exhausted, suspended, and error PAT counts.

/health.label: Health Check
/health.summary: Return service liveness status JSON ({ status: 'ok', message, timestamp }).
/health.aliases: Also served on GET / with Accept: application/json
